description: This Java source file defines the AppNavHomeActivity class, which is an Android ListActivity used as a home screen for app navigation samples. It dynamically queries other activities in the app that are categorized as sample code and displays them in a list. Clicking on an item launches the corresponding activity.

classes.name: AppNavHomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity that displays a list of sample activities available in the package and launches them upon selection.

classes.name: SampleInfo
classes.description: Data class representing a sample activity's display name and Intent.

classes.name: SampleAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for displaying SampleInfo objects in a list view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the list adapter with sample activities queried from the package.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by launching the selected sample activity.

methods.name: querySampleActivities
methods.description: Queries the package for activities categorized as sample code and returns a list of SampleInfo objects.
